headline: I lost what I had through someone I trusted. Is that still blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were hidden, but your hand found the one standing openly before you.
He stands behind his table, out in the open. Every tool is still there.
You asked whether the loss through someone you trusted is still blocking your money. What catches me is that open table.
The loss happened, and the money is still the question in front of you.
Something shows up right where the loss meets the money now. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see the figures, yet you chose the calmest man in the deck.
He hangs upside down by one ankle. Look at his face — it is calm.
You asked whether that loss still has hold of your money. This card makes me look at the calm around the restraint.
Still, the money remains blocked, and the loss is the event you placed beside it.
Something stands between what happened and the result. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing on the backs told you, but your hand went to the only card in full sun.
The sky behind him is gold. There is not one cloud in it.
You asked whether what happened still blocks the money. The full light on this card keeps drawing my eye.
But the money remains blocked, and the loss sits behind the question you asked.
The thing that has hold of the money keeps its grip without showing a person. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the money…
